categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of plastic products, focusing on synthetic resin products such as PVC flooring materials, artificial leather, tarpaulins, and automotive fabrics. It also engages in real estate sales and leasing, and automotive parts manufacturing. The business is organized as a single operating segment under corporate accounting standards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes calendering equipment to produce PVC artificial leather and flooring materials by blending PVC resin with additives like pigments, stabilizers, and plasticizers. It emphasizes environmentally friendly production methods, including the use of bio-based PVC materials. The company holds patents related to heat-diffusing heating sheets for flooring, enhancing product performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic automotive manufacturers, accounting for about 95% of artificial leather sales, with the remainder to other automotive makers via vendors. Flooring products are sold mainly domestically through dealers, with exports to China, the Middle East, South America, Southeast Asia, the US, and Europe. The company targets automotive, furniture, and construction sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and manufacturing are based in Ulsan, South Korea. The domestic market is the primary focus, especially for flooring products, while exports are directed to China, Middle East, South America, Southeast Asia, the US, and Europe. The company maintains a sales office in Seoul for domestic sales and engages in direct export sales internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing stage, producing finished synthetic resin products such as PVC flooring and artificial leather. It sources raw materials like resin and plasticizers from domestic and international suppliers and sells finished goods to distributors and end customers, including automotive manufacturers and dealers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D on environmentally friendly, non-toxic, and pollution-reducing products, aiming to develop high value-added technologies. It invests in sustainable product development, including bio-based PVC materials and differentiated artificial leather products to meet growing vegan leather demand. R&D expenses have been steadily maintained around 1% of sales.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of synthetic resin goods, including flooring and artificial leather, both domestically and via exports. The company also earns income from real estate leasing. Sales are conducted through direct factory shipments to dealers domestically and direct export sales internationally, with payment terms including letters of credit and cash or notes post-sale.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the PVC artificial leather market, the company competes with LX Hausys and Kolon Glotech, which dominate automotive applications. New entrants include Yuseong Chemical and Iljeong Industry. In flooring, competitors include LX Hausys, Hyundai L&C, and KCC Glass. The company claims competitive advantages in technology and price competitiveness, especially against emerging market producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023 year-end, the company reported total assets of approximately 499 billion KRW and equity of about 326 billion KRW, with a debt ratio around 53%. Annual sales were approximately 28.3 billion KRW, showing a slight decline of 2.8% from the prior year. The company recorded an operating loss of 2.1 billion KRW and a net loss of 2.2 billion KRW, reflecting increased depreciation and costs from recent facility investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high technical capability and price competitiveness in producing environmentally friendly PVC artificial leather and flooring products. It differentiates through the development of bio-based PVC materials and patented heating sheet technologies that improve product performance and sustainability. The firm also focuses on expanding vegan leather applications and maintaining strong customer relationships through quality and innovation.
